label: D1 after a rare a1->S2 transition (mostly unrewarded) while the agent leans toward repeating a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), almost exclusively when the previous trial was a1 that reached S2 by a rare transition (prev_common=0 holds 80% of mass; prev_action=2 only 2%), mostly unrewarded (93% of mass has prev_reward=0); this is the rare-unrewarded case where a model-based agent should repeat a1, and the D1 policy logit is strongly toward a1 (choice in [2.78, 8.07) holds 97% of mass). It is also linked to the S1-good regime. prev_common != 1 / prev_action != 2 deliberately admit the window first trial (rel -3) where the previous trial is outside the window (18% of mass), so that is a labeling artifact, not a future variable. The feature fades late in the episode (almost silent after trial 80), hence ep_trial < 80. Simpler versions: D1 & prev_action==1 & prev_common==0 gets dev F1 0.65 (0.73 with ep_trial<80). Rare-rewarded a1 trials give weaker activations (~0.3 of max). It does not fire on common-transition histories or after a2. All predicate variables are observed; no future variables used. Dev F1 0.78, mass recall 0.91.
